title: Quadratic PCPP proof length bound
statement: For every Boolean circuit $C$ with $n$ input bits and $g$ gates, its quadratic PCPP proof length is at most $3\cdot 2^{(n+g+1)^2}$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits
